english.meaning: to be willing to spend or give up something
english.note: This meaning is less certain: it was read from a few recorded conversations.

exampleSentences.english: Yeah, it’s really not worth it, so I’m willing to give it up too.
exampleSentences.traditional: 係呃，好唔抵囖，所以我都捨得𠸏。
exampleSentences.jyutping: hai6 aak3 hou2 m4 dai2 lo1 so2 ji5 ngo5 dou1 se2 dak1 ge2

exampleSentences.english: You’d obviously spend the money on the real thing. No point buying a fake—you wouldn’t look good taking it out.
exampleSentences.traditional: 實會捨得使錢落去買囖，冇理由話去買個冒牌嘅，你拎佢出去都唔好喇。
